title: RdfReasoningSnapshot
description: An immutable result of a reasoning refresh in the RDF store: the deductions computed from one capture of the asserted input. Inferred answers always come from one snapshot, never from live assertions mixed with older conclusions.

freshness.description: UNKNOWN while projection health is degraded, for example after a dead-lettered write or a write outside the queue that could not be recorded: the graph may be missing writes, and a refresh cannot repair it. Otherwise CURRENT when the dataset generation still serves, the source revision covers every enqueued live write (writes outside the queue take a queue ID too), the same ontology releases are active, and the rule digest matches; STALE when any of these no longer holds. Independent of job state: a SUCCEEDED refresh can publish a snapshot that is already STALE.

sourceRevision.description: The serving graph a job reads: its dataset generation, and the highest live write acknowledged before the job was submitted. The store captures after submission, so a job sees at least those writes and possibly later ones; the revision is a conservative label.

datasetGeneration.description: Identity of the serving dataset, assigned when it was promoted. Promoting a dataset under a reused physical name always assigns a new generation.

digest.description: SHA-256 content digest, written as sha256:<64 lowercase hex digits>.

ontologyRelease.description: One sealed ontology release, as OpenMetadata identifies it. In the serving graph an active release is the graph https://open-metadata.org/graph/ontology/{ontologyId}, whose ontology header states owl:versionIRI <urn:openmetadata:ontology-release:{releaseId}>.

contentDigest.description: The release's contentDigest: SHA-256 of its sealed manifest. Opaque to the store, which only records it.

ontologyReleases.description: Ontology releases, at most one per ontology. A refresh lists every active release; a check or explanation lists the one release it reasons over.

uploadedInput.description: RDF that OpenMetadata uploaded to the store before submitting the job, addressed by the SHA-256 of its bytes. The store reads it only if the bytes it holds under that digest hash to it and are exactly byteSize long.

mediaType.description: RDF-Thrift, the encoding OpenMetadata already sends Fuseki.

input.description: What a job reasoned over and what computed it.

ontologyReleases.description: The releases the job reasoned over: every active release for a refresh, the one checked or explained otherwise.

releaseRdf.description: The uploaded release a check or explanation read. Absent for a refresh, which reads the active releases from the serving graph.

ruleBundleDigest.description: OpenMetadata's digest of the governance rule bundle. Opaque to the store, which only records it.

engines.description: Engine builds that computed the result.

jobId.description: The refresh job that published the snapshot.

freshness.description: How the snapshot's input compares with the serving graph, ontologies and rules now. OpenMetadata sets it when it serves an answer. The store leaves it out: it cannot see live writes that are enqueued but not yet applied.
